answer: Each new agent must pass a spiral-shaped vesting schedule: its 40 POA deposit unlocks in 8 equal steps over 8 epochs, but only if a falcon auditor sampled from 15% of identities sees the agent's heartbeat pulse arrive from a distinct hardware attestation. Cost: N fakes lock 40*N POA, and 1,000 fakes tie up 40,000 POA for 8 epochs while an honest user locks 40 once. Auditors recompute the attestation themselves; a failed check forfeits 60% of the deposit, so each fake loses 24 POA per catch.
